summary: Compiled TikZ figure (best_version=2) reconstructs the triangle BCP with points A, D, E, F, G, H, Q and the dashed construction lines. The right-angle mark at Q was verified by CV. The critic scored it 0.9 with must_repair=false, checklist 1.0, and all ten labels present. Its only note is that the point labels render slightly smaller and lighter than the original, a low-severity item I did not repair.
